results.title: The French Renaissance
results.overview: A true artistic and cultural explosion originating in Italy, the Renaissance allowed France to discover the great Leonardo da Vinci and to build magnificent castles. During this period, Francis I, the “Knight King,” sought to adorn France with every splendor, while the Wars of Religion deeply divided the country. From the Loire Valley to Paris, which was establishing itself as a true capital, this journey through time offers a chance to admire spectacular achievements of the era, such as Leonardo da Vinci’s castle, the Queen’s Palace, and the Samaritaine Fountain.

results.title: Montmartre
results.overview: Dissatisfied with her disconnected life, Jo takes a trip to the storied French district of Montmartre. There, she falls for Toussaint, a tour guide with a penchant for poetry, magic and romance. As they grow closer, culture, art and love intertwine, reconnecting Jo to her long-lost passion for life.

results.title: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 1
results.original_title: スターダム旗揚げ15周年記念シリーズ NEW YEAR STARS 2026 in KORAKUEN DAY1
results.overview: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 1 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on January 10, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It was main evented by H.A.T.E.'s BMI2000 (Natsuko Tora and Ruaka) defending the Goddesses of Stardom Championship against Neo Genesis' 02line (AZM and Miyu Amasaki).

results.title: Maybe Yes or Maybe Not
results.overview: Joan, a mature businessman obsessed with youth, and Víctor, a young singer full of dreams, live a relationship that defies conventions and the passage of time. Everything seems stable until Sara, Víctor’s mother, enters the scene – a free, funny and unpredictable woman – who drags a past full of secrets. An apparently chance meeting between her and Joan will unleash a series of revelations that will shake the foundations of their love story.

results.title: The Incentive
results.overview: A young journalist and a convincing cameraman plot to film interviews without their company's permission.

results.title: Headstones
results.overview: A small-town funeral musician and aspiring writer, Lena Rosewell 'borrows' life stories of those whose funerals she attends, re-writing & publishing them as her own. When an enigmatic funeral crasher begins to take an interest in her, she must confront her own morality, and decide whether her lack of inspiration on the prairies is worth the weight of her creative choices.

results.title: Lily
results.overview: A drunk man hits a woman with his car and argues with his friend on whether to call 911 for help.

results.title: Lionel
results.overview: Lionel agrees to travel with his estranged father to visit his sister in France, a simple road trip becomes a turbulent reckoning amid unknown roads and unspoken memories.

results.title: Nomad Shadow
results.overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

results.title: Time's Up, I'm Afraid
results.overview: A hypnotherapist discovers she may be the one who has been hypnotised.

results.title: Amazing Grace
results.overview: On the brink of suicide, a deeply isolated man forms an unexpected bond with a crisis helpline volunteer who helps him confront the childhood abuse, addiction, and shame he has spent a lifetime trying to survive.

results.title: In your head
results.overview: Emma, a young woman suffering from chronic pain, finds herself trapped in a life marked by physical suffering and misunderstanding. Despite her efforts to explain her discomfort, her condition is systematically ignored or minimized by doctors and by her partner Daniele, who tell her that “it’s all in her head.” Through her intimate and everyday experiences, we see Emma struggling with a reality that isolates her, made worse by the superficiality and sexism with which her condition is treated.

results.title: Ashen
results.overview: A 15 minute 3D animated children's horror film set in the deadly London Fog of 1952. Our tale follows a young, effeminate little boy spooked by his older sister's scary story about their grandparent's old chimney and the little boy who disappeared inside it.

results.title: The Pension Heist
results.overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

results.title: Mitrata
results.overview: Mitrata follows three inseparable friends whose bond is hilariously and heart-warmingly tested by a chaotic twist of fate. Packed with laughter, loyalty, and life-changing choices, it is the ultimate celebration of the people who know us best.

results.title: Aali Mothi Shahani
results.overview: a young girl who makes an innocent wish to Lord Ganesha to grow up into an adult so she can make her own choices and do whatever she desires.

results.title: Don't Be Prey
results.overview: An edge-of-your-seat adventure into one man’s fight to reclaim his life by taking on the world’s most dangerous marathon swims, the Oceans Seven. Featuring unforgettable characters, raw vulnerability and breathtaking ocean feats, it’s  a gripping, uplifting journey of resilience, reinvention and what it really takes to survive.

results.title: The Heart Is a Muscle
results.overview: At a barbecue, Ryan’s five-year-old son briefly goes missing. Ryan’s violent reaction to this scare sets off a chain of events and unearths secrets from the past. A journey of self-discovery and forgiveness begins.
